notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=FjG7KU6-n5k;full][/previewyoutube]
This update brings a wealth of new content and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience.

Key Features:

Fresh Start: Dive into a completely revamped main menu designed for intuitive navigation and a stunning visual experience.

-Test Your Mettle: Embark on an unlimited challenge in Survival Mode, where you'll face an endless stream of opponents with limited resources at your disposal. 

-Master the Art of Combat: Delve into Challenge Mode, a dedicated space to meticulously practice and optimize each character's combo potential.

-Sharpen Your Edge: Put your skills to the test against the CPU in Training Mode. 

Please Note:

This is a beta version, and some visual assets and data may not be final. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us polish the final build, so please don't hesitate to share any issues or suggestions you encounter.

To access the beta, simply right-click the app, select "Properties," and navigate to the "Betas" tab. Choose the "beta" option.

We're confident this update will inject a thrilling new dimension into your experience.

Join the conversation and share your feedback! We're eager to hear what you think.

notes.title: March 2021 Update
notes.notes:
The new update should be live on the Beta branch on March 11th and will go live on March 16th.

This update will feature the following:

Color Select

 Each character will get 2 more extra colors in addition to the current 2 colors.
 More colors will be available to be unlocked by clearing some single-player modes that will be added in future updates.


Frame Data
Turning on Attack Data in the Training Pause Menu will display the following:

 The Startup speed of each attack.
 The Advantage and Disadvantage when hitting or blocking.


Dummy Reversal Action
By pressing the Left or Right Shoulder Buttons on the controller (or I and O on Keyboard) in Training Pause Menu.
You can access the Advanced Training features which include the following:

 Reversal Attack when Dummy blocks.
 Reversal Attack when Dummy gets hit.
 Reversal Attack when Dummy Wakes Up.


more content will be announced later, stay tuned.

notes.title: September Update
notes.notes:
This is the first major update for Queens Conquest and it features the following additions:

- Power Sheild.
By pressing Back or Down Back together with the Punch and Kick Button you will deploy a powerful shield that prevents you from losing health while blocking and pushes you further away from your opponent.

- Custom Combos
By holding forward and rapidly pressing the Punch button after any normal standing punch you will easily perform some cool looking combos.
it can also be done in the air.

-Command Normals
Both Characters got some new moves.

Venicia: 
* Forward + Punch
* Back + Slash
* Forward + Hack

Cedric: 
* Forward + Punch
* Forward + Hack
